interfaces.name: contact_face
interfaces.why: the end face carrying the +, − (and any data) contacts that the banana contact PCB (clamped by part:microduck-banana-pcb-locker) mates to. No vendor drawing of the NP-F contact face was found (electrical.part.json pinout.why); Pollen's mesh is a box with no contact features. Frame and contact pitch are unmeasured — a physical pack or a plate vendor's drawing settles it.

interfaces.name: cradle_envelope
interfaces.why: the 38.6 x 20.6 x 70.8 mm envelope (component.json bbox_basis, cited from Pollen's mesh) that sits in part:microduck-power-support. The mesh is placed in the assembly by Pollen's MJCF transform, but no anchor frame on this part has been measured off geometry here — the folder has no geometry file of its own yet.
